delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Only an empty workspace can be deleted: move or delete its bases first, including those in the trash. This cannot be undone.

trash.title: Deleted bases
trash.hint: Bases deleted from this workspace that you can restore.

import.title: Import base from a .chbase file
import.description: The base is created in {{workspace}}, with you as its owner.
import.limits: A package exported from Cellhive, up to {{size}} in the browser. Larger packages: cellhive base import.
import.trust: Import packages only from people you trust. Automations arrive turned off, and nobody else can open the base until you add members.

problems.extension: {{name}} is not a .chbase package. Export a base from Base settings › Export base to get one.
problems.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than any instance accepts ({{size}}). Import it with the command line: cellhive base import.

import.tooLarge: The package is larger than this instance accepts in the browser ({{size}}). Import it with the command line: cellhive base import.
import.uploading: Keep this window open until the file is uploaded.
import.queued: Waiting for another import of this organization to finish.
import.running: You can close this window: the import goes on, and the base appears in this workspace when it is done.

report.title: {{name}} is ready
report.subtitle: Imported into {{workspace}}. Check what needs your attention before you share the base.

automations.title: Automations are off
automations.body_one: {{count, number}} automation was imported turned off. Turn it on once what it uses is set up again.
automations.body_other: {{count, number}} automations were imported turned off. Turn each one on once what it uses is set up again.

reconnect.title: Set up again
reconnect.body: These stayed in the source organization. Create or choose them here, then pick them in each automation that uses them.

people.title: People not found
people.body: These people of the package are not members of this organization: their cells, creators and reminders were left empty.

ai.title: AI fields
ai.body: Their values were imported. Nothing is generated until AI is set up in this organization.

views.title: Personal views left out
views.body_one: {{count, number}} personal view of the source base was not exported: a personal view stays with its owner.
views.body_other: {{count, number}} personal views of the source base were not exported: a personal view stays with its owner.

files.title: Files left out
files.body: The cells keep their other files.

reasons.content_mismatch: content does not match its type

failed.title: This package cannot be imported
failed.nothingLeft: Nothing was created: no base, table or file was left behind.
failed.cancelled: The import was cancelled. Nothing was created.
